title: status --stats separates citation drift from invented citations
desc:
sdd audit exited 7 in 7 of 33 runs in this repo's event log. The log cannot tell a moved line number (bookkeeping cost) from a mismatch or missing_file (a claim that was never true) -- the second is the hallucination rate and the number worth watching.

ACCEPTANCE:
- the event record for sdd audit (and cite check once it exists) carries counts per verdict
- wb status --stats reports mismatch/missing_file separately from moved/out_of_range over the log's history
- old log lines without the counts are read without error
- tests
